title: Sports Team Triples Daily Ticket Conversions After Adding Premium TV Inventory
summary: The post Sports Team Triples Daily Ticket Conversions After Adding Premium TV Inventory appeared first on MNTN .
body_markdown:
A professional sports team had been running prospecting and retargeting on MNTN for several seasons, with ROAS as its measure of success, tracked from impression to ticket purchase. The always-on campaigns were efficient, but prospecting alone was not growing the audience fast enough to keep the retargeting pool full ahead of a September push for the team’s highest-demand home event.


The 2026 World Cup offered a window. For five weeks, sports fans of every kind were watching premiere events by the tens of millions, and many of those viewers in the team’s market were not yet in its ticketing funnel. The team wanted to reach them at scale, grow its retargeting pool, and hold a healthy ROAS across the full account while adding awareness spend on top of it.
